q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an IV fluid bottle?
title: IV fluid bottle carbon footprint per bottle
short: Add the plastic bottle, closure, salts and water treatment per bottle, then the blow-fill-seal machine electricity and steam for terminal sterilisation. Divide the plant's energy by bottles released and report by volume.
audience: IV fluid and large volume parenteral makers

ul: Polypropylene or LDPE granules for the bottle.
Sodium chloride, dextrose and other salts.
Autoclave sterilisation with steam, then inspection.

p: Report per bottle by millilitres. Water for injection and sterilisation steam are large energy uses, so meter them.

example.title: Worked example: IV fluid bottle unit per bottle (one month)
lines: Plant total: 97,800 / 1,000,000 = 0.0978 kg CO2 per bottle
Add polymer, salts and packing for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
